more_info.overview: Citranaxanthin is an apo-carotenoid ketone, whose carbon skeleton is shorter than that of beta-carotene. The chemical record identifies colouring activity. This historical entry concerns that particular pigment rather than the carotenoid family as a whole. A typical current food example and commercial manufacturing route were not confirmed.
